cases.description: Anisotropy index above 1: DNI (1450) exceeds the early-January extraterrestrial normal irradiance, as noisy measured data can, so the Hay-Davies isotropic sky term is negative before clipping — pvlib clips each sky component at zero separately, and a port that clipped only their sum would agree everywhere else
Inverter clipping: DC x 0.96 exceeds nameplate, so AC is exactly capacityKw
